items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Why didn’t they get a jazz guy? Johnny Mandel or all the guys that were around that could write jazz music?

ctx.x: Yeah. He sounded wonderful on that but apparently they didn’t like the writing very much so they hired Joe Lipman for the other dates. He was much more of a jazz guy.
Why didn’t they get a jazz guy? Johnny Mandel or all the guys that were around that could write jazz music?
I guess they just didn’t know.
